response.sql:
WITH per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF') as order_id,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF')
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaincount) as overall_avg
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    poa.order_id,
    poa.avg_remain,
    poa.avg_remain - oav.overall_avg as excess_over_overall
  FROM per_order_avg poa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oav
  WHERE poa.avg_remain > oav.overall_avg
),
group_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as group_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_selection AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.avg_remain,
    ao.excess_over_overall,
    ao.avg_remain - gav.group_avg as excess_over_group
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN group_avg_val gav
  WHERE ao.avg_remain > gav.group_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remain) as avg_of_final_averages,
  AVG(excess_over_overall) as avg_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(excess_over_group) as avg_excess_over_group
FROM final_selection

assumptions.assumption: The group's own average (for filtering the second time) refers to the average of the per-order averages of orders above the overall average, not the average of raw remaincount values from those orders' executions.

alternatives.interpretation: The group's own average is the simple average of all remaincount values from executions belonging to orders above the overall average (weighted by execution count per order, rather than treating each order's average equally).

WITH per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF') as order_id,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF')
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaincount) as overall_avg
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall_with_excess AS (
  SELECT 
    poa.order_id,
    poa.avg_remain,
    poa.avg_remain - oav.overall_avg as excess_over_overall
  FROM per_order_avg poa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oav
  WHERE poa.avg_remain > oav.overall_avg
),
group_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(oe.remaincount) as group_avg
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(oe.ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF') IN (
      SELECT order_id FROM above_overall_with_excess
    )
),
final_selection AS (
  SELECT 
    aowe.avg_remain,
    aowe.excess_over_overall,
    aowe.avg_remain - gav.group_avg as excess_over_group
  FROM above_overall_with_excess aowe
  CROSS JOIN group_avg_val gav
  WHERE aowe.avg_remain > gav.group_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remain) as avg_of_final_averages,
  AVG(excess_over_overall) as avg_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(excess_over_group) as avg_excess_over_group
FROM final_selection
